title: Spiders Can Fly Using Earth's Electric Field

scenes.text: Young spiders climb to a tip and stand on tiptoe.
Researchers found their leg hairs react to Earth's electric field.
In a lab, spiders lifted off when a field was switched on.
They drop back down when it's switched off.
Charles Darwin found tiny spiders on his ship, at least sixty miles from land.
They fly on electricity, no wings needed.

description:
Spiders can fly using electricity.
A University of Bristol study found their leg hairs react to Earth's electric field, helping them lift off. Darwin found spiders on his ship at least sixty miles from land.
Could you fly if you had silk?
first_comment: Bonus: Darwin wrote that he caught spiders that must have come at least 60 miles. How far can they really go?
